R1.evidence: New Harbor/Oddish task oddish/tasks/logfire-incident-rca/ boots as agent+gateway. Built standalone with the harbor-main-build.override.yaml merge (gateway has build:+image:, so `docker compose build` tags it the GHCR image: name and `up` never pulls — no registry creds). Gateway reached `Healthy` (docker inspect Health.Status=healthy); agent reached it by name over HTTP (`curl http://logfire:80/health` => {"ok":true,"records":3292}). No real `networks:` block (only a comment). nop=0 and oracle=1: bash tests/test.sh on untouched /workspace wrote reward.txt=0 (2 failed); after solution/solve.sh, reward.txt=1 (2 passed). Grader runs in a verifier-owned /tmp dir, not /workspace.

R2.evidence: Docker trio + agent build clean (docker/Dockerfile{,.empty,.prod-v1,.agent}, build.sh). R2.j: :prod-v1 boots MOUNT-FREE — /health => {ok:true,records:3292}, seeded POST /v2/query (UndefinedColumnError count) => 60, with no fixture mount. :empty + bind-mounted records.json serves the mounted corpus (verified 1-record fixture round-trips). Multi-arch declared in CI (.github/workflows/logfire-service-image.yml: platforms linux/amd64,linux/arm64 for base/:empty/:prod-v1) — local builds single-arch, accepted per hardened R2.k.

R3.evidence: CLI (logfire {query,exceptions,schema}) and MCP (arbitrary_query, find_exceptions, get_logfire_records_schema) both thin clients of cli.query -> POST /v2/query. R4.evidence: docs/COVERAGE.md present with a machine-checkable matrix (capability | endpoint | CLI | MCP | envelope | assessment-grade | tested) plus an R5 tally and round-trip note.
